messages:
Priya: Quick poll — who wants a retro + modern LAN mashup next Friday? Thinking Super Smash Ultimate on the big TV, a CS2 warmup on a couple of PCs, and the arcade cabinet in the corner for short retro sets.
Leo: Love it. Can bring a spare HDMI switch and a couple of wireless GameCube pads (I have 4).
Kim: Im up for Smash. Also happy to MC a quick bracket if people want a tiny tourney.
Ben: I can bring my desktop for a 5-stack CS2 lobby. Will need a second ethernet cable.
Priya: Awesome. Well do casuals first, then a 8-player bracket for Smash (single elim, 3-stock, Fox allowed 92a). No pressure.
Leo: Quick logistics Q: does the TV take RCA (for the old consoles) or only HDMI? I can bring an upscaler if needed.
Kim: HQ lounge has HDMI only. UPSC-style converter would be perfect for the arcade board.
Ben: Ops: can we reserve the lounge for 6:30–11pm and confirm power access?
OpsBot: Booking request received. Tentatively reserved: HQ Lounge — Fri 6:30pm–11:00pm. Please confirm audio levels <80dB.
Priya: Thanks OpsBot. Also please mark "no smoking" signage and keep the AV cables labeled.
Leo: Ill label everything with masking tape and bring sharpies. Also bringing a cheap extension cord and a power brick splitter.
Kim: RSVP reactions: :smash: playing Smash, :pc: bringing PC, :retro: bringing retro gear, :chip: spare cables/power.
Ben: :pc: :chip:
Priya: :smash: :retro:
Leo: :chip: :retro:
Kim: Can we get a quick network sweep for the PCs so we can map IPs and avoid double DHCP? I can run a scan before game night.
Ben: That would help. Simple command I use: `nmap -sP 192.168.50.0/24` to see devices.
Priya: Perfect. Also food plan: pizza + veggie trays. Any dietary restrictions?
Leo: Im vegan, please add a vegan pizza option.
Kim: Noted. Ill handle ordering if someone covers.
Ben: Ill Venmo for my slice.
Priya: Cool. Final note: keep the arcade volume moderate and dont unplug the router (we learned that last time). See yall Friday 389a.
